113
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the August 22, 2005/Sravana 31, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Culture; Development of North-Eastern Region; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development;
Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 20
 Conservation and restoration of
statue of Lord Gomateshwara
*361. SHRI LALIT SURI:
DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the world's
tallest statue of Lord Gomateshwara and
its supporting structures need to be
strengthened;
(b) if so, the steps undertaken by the
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) for
conservation and restoration of the heritage
structure; and
(c) whether there is any proposal with
the ASI for installing a lightning conductor
to protect the statue?
Dues of Post Matric Scholarship
Scheme
*362. SHRI  DATTA MEGHE:
SHRI VASANT CHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a huge accumulation of dues,
under 100 per cent Centrally sponsored
Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for the
Other Backward Classes is to be paid to
the Government of Maharashtra and other
States;
(b) if so, the amount thereof, due to
each of the States as on the 31st March
2002, 2003, 2004 and 2005; and
(c) the reasons for growing accumulation
and the steps taken for regular clearance of
such dues?
Financial assistance to Sanskrit
Pandits
*363. SHRI  SURENDRA LATH:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that two Sanskrit Pandits from
Sikkim were granted Financial Assistance
by Government for subsistence till
2003-04;
(b) whether for the financial years
2001-02, 2002-03 and 2003-04 a sum of
Rs. 85,000/- was sanctioned and given to

114
the HRD Department of the Government
of Sikkim and an amount of Rs. 55,000/-
only was paid to the Pandits for three years
as backlog, if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether it is a fact that for the year
2004-05 they have not been paid till date
and if so, the reasons therefor?
Listing of education in VII schedule
*364. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many States
have been demanding shifting of 'Education'
from the Concurrent List to the State List;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether Government recognise the
diverse socio-cultural ethos of this country
according to which the school curriculum
has to be shaped; and
(d) whether Government would bring a
constitutional amendment to shift
'Education' to the State List?
Human Scavengers
*365. SHRI  NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of URBAN EMPLOYMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there were 6,76,009 human
scavengers engaged throughout the country,
during 1992-1993;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) the existing number of human
scavengers, State-wise, as on date;
(d) the details of the budget released
and spent during the years 2002-03, 2003-
04 and 2004-05, State-wise, for
implementing the National Scheme of
Liberation and Rehabilitation of Scavengers
and their dependents; and
(e) the number of human scavengers and
their dependents rehabilitated under this
Scheme, State-wise, during  the above
period?
Encroachment on Tomb of Mirza
Ghalib
*366. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI LALIT SURI:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the Tomb of Mirza Ghalib, the renowned
poet, situated within the Hazrat
Nizamuddin's complex in Delhi has been
encroached;
(b) if so, what steps have been taken by
the Archaeological Survey of India to
remove the encroachment; and
(c) whether any expert committee has
been constituted to protect world heritage
sites and monuments in Mehrauli
Archaeological Park, Lal Gumbaz, Firoz
Shah Kotla, Mubarkshan Tomb and other
such monuments in Delhi?
Domestic violence
*367. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been considerable
increase in domestic violence against
women during 2004-05;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the measures Government are taking
to check this trend; and
(d) the number of  cases registered during
the year and the number of persons
prosecuted?

115
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Deemed universities
*368. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of deemed universities
sanctioned in the country, State-wise;
(b) whether such universities can open
and start any college in other States; and
(c) whether Government are aware that
unrecognised colleges in various f

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the August 22, 2005/Sravana 31, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Culture; Development of North Eastern Region; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information
and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Parliamentary Affairs;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban
Development; Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 155
Conservation of World Heritage
sites
2659. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
UNESCO has expressed concern over
conservation of the World Heritage Sites
(WHS) in the country;
(b) if so, whether UNESCO has called
for greater ASI role in maintenance of
WHS;
(c) if so, the steps taken by the ASI in
this regard;
(d) whether any team of UNESCO has
visited the country recently to inspect the
WHS;
(e) if so, the details of the report
submitted by the said team; and
(f) the steps taken by Government
thereon?
Survey for restoration of manuscripts
2660. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are conducting
any survey to conserve and restore
manuscripts;
(b) if so, whether Government had set
up any committee for this purpose;
(c) if so, the details of such survey taking
place in the States/UTs;
(d) whether it is also a fact that
Government are facing problem in tracking
down experienced practitioners of
traditional conservation methods who live
in far-flung areas;
(e) if so, the details thereof;
(f) whether it is also a fact that
Government are taking preservation
feedback from the traditional Sri Lankan
experts;
(g) if so, the details thereof; and
(h) the expenditure incurred thereon?

404
Renovation of Mahaprasad Market of
Jagannath Temple
2661. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Orissa has asked the
Archaeological Survey of India to expedite
renovation of Mahaprasad Market of the
holy Jagannath Temple, popularly known
as Anand Bazar;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for delay in execution of
the renovation work; and
(d) by when, it would be completed?
Language policy of NSD
2662. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the language policy of NSD
especially after grant of deemed University
status;
(b) the number of plays staged by NSD
repertory and students, language-wise,
during the last two years, indicating
Director's name and cost of production
including remuneration paid to each
Director;
(c) the achievements of Regional
Resource-cum-Research Centre so far;
(d) the details of the proposals to open
new Regional Centres;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(f) the details of the activities
undertaken by Sanskaar Rang Toli during
the last two years?
Maintenance of monuments
2663. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the monuments/sites
under maintenance of the Archaelogical
Survey of India (ASI), State-wise;
(b) the monuments/sites proposed to
be taken over for maintenance, by ASI,
State-wise; and
(c) the details of the funds allocated for
the purpose during the last three years?
Protected monuments
2664. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the monuments being
protected by the Archaeological Survey of
India as on date, State-wise;
(b) the amount spent by Government
during the last three years;
(c) the efforts made by Government to
develop the above as places of tourists;
(d) whether certain monuments are in a
dilapidated condition and are on the verge
of collapse;
(e) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(f) the steps being taken by Government
for protection of such monuments?
One hundred fiftieth anniversary
of 1857
2665. DR. CHANDAN MITRA:
SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry

405
has earmarked a sum of Rs. 100 crore for
celebrating the 150th anniversary of the
events of 1857, also known as the first war
of Indian Independence;
(b) whether sponsorship of an official
history of the uprising of 1857, part of the
proposed celebrations;
(c) if so, the historian who have been
commissioned to write this volume(s);
(d) the basis on which historians have
identified for the project, or if they are yet
to be selected on what criteria they shall be
chosen for this project; and
(e) whether both the Pakistan and
Bangladesh have agreed to join in these
celebrations and if so, the details thereof?
Observation of UNESCO on World
Heritage Sites
2666. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that any delegation
of UNESCO has recently visited to examine
the three World Heritage Sites in Agra-Taj,
